Methodology

About WageGrid

A static slice of BLS OEWS May 2025 for three metros and 25 occupations. Built to be cited, regenerated, and killed if it does not earn attention.

Source

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. Tables and series: bls.gov/oes/tables.htm. Retrieval method for this build: BLS Public Data API (OE metro series, May 2025).

WageGrid is an independent publication. It is not a BLS product and is not endorsed by the U.S. Department of Labor.

What the numbers mean

OEWS estimates wages and employment for wage-and-salary workers. They exclude self-employed workers. Means and medians are survey estimates, not job-posting averages. Location quotient is the metro concentration of the occupation relative to the national mix.

BLS suppresses some cells for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid leaves those cells blank. Do not treat a dash as zero.

Some occupations, especially teachers, are published annual-only. When hourly mean and median are both unpublished, pages show annual wages only.

Ads

Pages include an empty AdSense slot. No ad script ships until a publisher ID is added.
